spans.s: प्रति—गज m. = -कुञ्जर, MBh.; Hariv.
प्रति—गात्रम् ind. in every limb (only ibc.), Dhūrtas.
प्रति—गिरि m. an opposite mountain, BhP.
प्रति—गु ind. against a cow, Mn. iv, 52.
प्रति-√ गु (only Intens. -जो॑गुवे), to proclaim, RV.
प्रति—गृहम् (KātyŚr.) ind. in every house.
प्रति—गेहम् (Rājat.) ind. in every house.
प्रति—ग्रामम् ind. in every village, Rājat.
प्रति—ग्राम˚-समीपम् ind. near every v˚, Dharmaś.
प्रति-√ गद् P. -गदति, to speak in return, answer, MBh.

प्रति-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go towards, go to meet, RV.; MBh. &c.;
to go back, return, go home, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रति-˚गत mfn. gone towards or back, MBh.
flying backwards and forwards, wheeling in flight, W.
lost from the memory, R.
प्रति-˚गति f. (L.) return.
प्रति-˚गमन n. (R.) return.
प्रति-˚गर्जन n. (AV.Pariś.) thundering or roaring against or in return, an answering roar.
प्रति-˚गर्जना f. (MBh.) thundering or roaring against or in return, an answering roar.
प्रति-√ गा (only aor. -अगात्), to go back, return.
प्रति-√ गाह् Ā. -गाहते, to penetrate, enter, R.
guarded protected, Inscr.
प्रति-˚गु॑प्य mfn. to be guarded
प्रति-˚गु॑प्यम् (अम्), ind. one must guard against (abl.), ŚBr.
प्रति-√ गृध् P. -गृध्यति, to be greedy or eager for (acc.), MBh.

Nom. P. ˚यति, to take, receive;
 (esp.) to take into the mouth, eat, RV.
प्रति-˚गर॑ m. the responsive call of the Adhvaryu to the address of the Hotṛ, TS.; Br.; ĀśvŚr.
प्रति-˚गरितृ m. one who makes a responsive cry or chant, AitBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
प्रति-˚गीर्य mfn. to be answered in recitation or chanting, AitBr.
प्रति-˚गृहीत mfn. taken, received, accepted, married, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रति-˚गृहीतव्य w.r. for ˚ग्रहीतव्य
प्रति-˚गृहीतृ w.r. for ˚ग्रहीतृ.
प्रति-˚गृ॑ह्य mfn. to be accepted, acceptable, TS. (‘from’ gen. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 118,
Vārtt. 1
, Pat.)
one from whom anything may be accepted (see अ-प्रतिगृह्य॑).
प्रति-˚ग्रह॑ m. receiving, accepting, acceptance of gifts (as the peculiar prerogative of Brāhmans; cf.
; 262), ŚBr.; ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (˚ग्रहं-√ कृ, to receive presents, Mn.)
friendly reception, MBh.
favour, grace, MBh.
taking a wife, marrying, R.
receiving with the ear i.e. hearing, Kathās.
a grasper, seizer (केश-, a hair-cutter, barber), Gobh. a receiver, KātyŚr.; R.
a chamber-vessel or any similar convenience for sick persons, Car.
a spittoon, L.
a gift, present (esp. a donation to a Brāhman at suitable periods), Yājñ.; MBh. &c. (instr. ‘as a present’, Kathās.)
N. of the objects or functions corresponding to the 8 Grahas, L.
= क्रिया-कार, L.
the reserve of an army (a detachment posted with the general 400 yards in the rear of a line), W.
the sun near the moon's node, ib.
प्रति-˚ग्राह m. a spittoon, L.
accepting gifts, W.
प्रति-˚ग्रह—कल्प m. N. of Pariśiṣṭa of MānGṛS.
प्रति-˚ग्रह—धन n. money received as a present, Kathās.
प्रति-˚ग्रह—धन mfn. one whose wealth consists only in presents, Pañcat.
प्रति-˚ग्रह—प्राप्त mfn. received as a present, Kathās.
प्रति-˚ग्रह—प्रायश्चित्त-प्रकार m. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚ग्रहण mfn. accepting, ŚāṅkhGṛ. (perhaps w.r.)
प्रति-˚ग्रहण n. receipt, acceptance, ib.; Lāṭy.
taking a wife, marrying, R. (cf. अ॑-प्रतिग्˚)
a vessel, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
प्रति-˚ग्रहणीय mfn. to be taken or accepted, acceptable, W.
प्रति-˚ग्रहिन् mfn. one who receives, a receiver (opp. to दातृ), MBh.
प्रति-˚ग्राहि॑न् mfn. id., TS.
प्रति-˚ग्रहीतव्य mfn. to be received, Kull.
प्रति-˚ग्रहीतृ॑ mfn. id., AV. &c. &c.
प्रति-˚ग्रहीतृ॑ m. one who takes a wife, one who marries (nom. ˚ता, also as 3. sg. fut.), MBh.; R.
प्रति-˚ग्राहक mfn. one who receives or accepts (see अ॑-प्रतिग्˚).
प्रति-˚ग्राह्य mfn. to be taken or accepted, acceptable, MBh.; R. (cf. अ-प्रतिग्˚)
one from whom anything may be received, MBh. (cf. ˚गृह्य and Pāṇ.; ib.)
प्रति-˚ग्राह्य m. N. of partic. Grahas, TBr., Sch.
